system.description:
Lore: Relic Bag (Consumable)

Perfectly ordinary beans. That is the problem. It has the following Powers:

  • Sprouting: Plant a bean and something happens - a treant, a geyser, a rain of toads, or a small, extremely angry monster. Roll on the DM's table.

Value: 2000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
